fields.v: Proposes an evaluation method; secondary: Proposes an approach — roundtrip benchmark scoring descriptions by whether code regenerated from them passes the original tests (contribution 1); benchmark-driven optimizer of the describe prompt; also evaluates whether such documentation helps issue resolution (negative result)
fields.quote: We make three contributions. (1) A roundtrip benchmark that scores a describer, the system producing a naturallanguage description, by whether code regenerated from its description alone passes the original tests, together with a compression measure and controls for memorization.
fields.why: The benchmark is the first stated contribution and in the title, so 'Proposes an evaluation method' is a plausible main nature that the current value omits entirely.
fields.doubt: O benchmark roundtrip é a 1.ª contribuição e está no título, mas a natureza não refere 'Proposes an evaluation method'. Lê o fim da introdução (pág. 1) e decide se a natureza principal deve ser essa (mantendo 'Proposes an approach' como secundária, para o Q13 continuar a aplicar-se).
